scope: Historical backfill plus preserved 30 existing slugs. Broad partial identity/generation catalogue, not a full technical or global-history claim.
gaps: Many imported model families still have only one overview record. Full Corsa/Astra/Vectra/Insignia/Zafira/Meriva/Mokka/Grandland generations prioritized.
Historic additional tax-horsepower subseries, regional badges and detailed road LCV configurations remain open.
No production end guessed from successor or website availability. Many exact variant/body dates remain null.

Only Astra K/L, Corsa F, Mokka B and Grandland II have technical rows. Priority follow-up: Vectra A–C, Insignia A/B, Zafira A–C, Meriva A/B, Crossland and all older Astra/Corsa. High-volume make is NOT complete.
CZ current price-list diagrams need independent dimensional transcription; no dimensions guessed. Mokka ICE/hybrid consumption row mislabels units as kWh/100km, so values withheld.
Hybrid engine fields explicitly combustion-engine power/torque; system power is in version names/scope. No mixed engine/system composite.
Inherited one-record families (Agila, Combo, Frontera, Omega, Senator, Tigra, Movano/Vivaro etc.) still require full generation split.
